name: Ectoplasmic Grasp
description: A massive ectoplasmic hand forms around a creature and squeezes it.
disable: DC 24 Occultism (trained) to send the ectoplasm back to the Ethereal Plane or DC 26 Acrobatics to move through and disrupt the coalescing ectoplasm before it takes hold

generalAbilities.name: Squeeze
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature moves over the haunt's area

Effect The hand forms out of ectoplasm and squeezes the triggering creature, dealing (3d8+14) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw). On a failure, the creature is Immobilized (Escape dc=22).
